definition.en: MSMEs are the backbone of the Indian economy, defined by specific investment and turnover criteria under the MSMED Act to promote industrial growth and employment.
definition.hi: MSMEs are the backbone of the Indian economy, defined by specific investment and turnover criteria under the MSMED Act to promote industrial growth and employment.

importanceInUpsc.en: MSMEs are a critical component of the GS-3 syllabus, frequently appearing in questions related to industrial policy, employment generation, and inclusive growth. Understanding their classification and challenges is essential for analyzing government schemes and economic reforms.
importanceInUpsc.hi: MSMEs are a critical component of the GS-3 syllabus, frequently appearing in questions related to industrial policy, employment generation, and inclusive growth. Understanding their classification and challenges is essential for analyzing government schemes and economic reforms.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the revised classification criteria for MSMEs.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the revised classification criteria for MSMEs.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the role of MSMEs in the Indian economy and their contribution to GDP and exports.
